boundary.label: Bounded kernel prefix: 65,536 instructions; display unverified
boundary.detail: The unchanged macOS 27 input reaches 65,536 instructions and 11,702 data operations. Run-local native reuse preserves the reported state and observed requests while reducing permission transitions. The framebuffer remains all zero; normal startup and physical display remain unverified.

headline: Building the path to a real macOS desktop

milestones.title: EFI recovery
milestones.summary: Picker display failures and child-return recovery have authored OVMF evidence. Physical firmware coverage is pending.

milestones.title: A64 startup execution
milestones.summary: Freshly fetched native entries are reused within each v1 provider run. Independent native and EFI comparisons preserve execution and memory requests. The original prefix remains bounded at 65,536 instructions; full initialization and userspace are unverified.

milestones.title: Normal kernel handoff
milestones.summary: Normal startup returns NOT_READY. A complete validated entry profile, platform services and live mappings are not implemented.

milestones.title: Non-accelerated desktop output
milestones.summary: An authored guest reads encoded boot-video fields, writes its owned framebuffer and passes exact GOP RGB readback in OVMF. Persistent presentation, normal startup and a physical desktop remain unverified.

milestones.title: Install and reboot on physical hardware
milestones.summary: No physical macOS 27 desktop, installation or reboot has been demonstrated by this project.

metrics.label: Physical macOS desktops verified
metrics.detail: No model is certified as booting macOS 27 through Nextcore.

metrics.label: Completed public CI checkpoint
metrics.detail: 31 successful checks on development revision 5dc67f08. Later cache integration checks are tracked separately; CI is not physical boot proof.

metrics.label: Latest bounded prefix
metrics.detail: Retired instructions in an isolated OVMF diagnostic.

latest.title: Native reuse preserves execution while reducing EFI permission changes
latest.summary: Thirteen native differential cases and five mutation controls pass. Final EFI framebuffer and long-loop comparisons preserve results, including the mandatory permission restore. The original macOS framebuffer remains all zero.

latest.title: Observed kernel memory progress and reliable trace collection
latest.summary: The long prefix completes 11,702 data operations. Its final store is 17,872 bytes beyond the earlier checkpoint. Fragmented UART records and transient read failures are handled without claiming a visible macOS screen.

latest.title: Owned guest framebuffer connects to firmware display
latest.summary: Nine authored checks pass at 1280 by 800 pixels, including exact GOP RGB readback after guest writes. Without GOP, the CPU diagnostic still completes 64 instructions while video reports NOT_FOUND and remains unverified. This is firmware evidence, not a macOS desktop.
BFM/BFI/BFXIL/BFC source tests, a 64-instruction authored EFI consumer and the unchanged captured-Arm comparator pass. The local kernel prefix reaches its 16,384-instruction limit.
